cars.specification_market: Mercedes-Benz factory 60-year retrospective identifies March 1963 Geneva presentation. Select the original two-seat 230 SL. Later 250/280 engines, rear disc brakes and California rear bench are not transferred. The removable hardtop and four-speed automatic were optional. No gearbox-specific acceleration or universal first-safety-body claim is imported. One W113 generation is counted.
cars.summary: The W113 Pagoda is a lasting Mercedes sports-car design icon that combined its distinctive removable roof with a reinforced passenger cell and crumple zones. The original 230 SL represents this substantive safety and touring-sports-car landmark, rather than adding later engines or roof options as separate cars.

cars.variant: FPV F6 310 — January 2009 Australian six-speed manual
cars.specification_market: Original Ford Performance Vehicles F6-series brochure printed January 2009, pages 2 and 5. Read the F6 sedan column, not ute, F6X SUV, later F6 E or FG Mk II. Native DIN kW/Nm are retained; the 565-Nm qualification uses 98 RON premium unleaded. ZF automatic is a no-cost option; premium six-piston brakes are optional and not imported as standard. One absent FG Falcon generation is counted.
cars.summary: The FG FPV F6 exemplifies Australia’s distinctive high-output turbo six-cylinder performance-saloon tradition. Its broad torque delivery, manual gearbox and dedicated chassis/brakes earned enthusiastic contemporary driving assessments, giving this locally engineered Falcon generation a substantive sporting identity beyond a cosmetic edition.
